name: mc-assets
description: Minecraft assets every film shares: the props pack (pack/assets/gohans, pack.ts) and what makes props work (gamefont, ink, screen, variants for the studio), block-model-renderer's runtime files (vendor.mjs, a film's postinstall), blocks cherry-picked from the vault's mod packs (pick.py), what the creator drops into a scene from the studio (placed). MineRender's mob dataset mirrored into the vault (mobs.ts, for mc-actor/mob). The game itself, the rig and the clips stay in the vault (vault.json, bun run link).
